# decisions/ — the record

Records here are written by agents as `PROPOSED` and ratified by the operator as `RULED`
(CORE §3). A record stays until it is superseded or describes only retired shapes; then it is
removed with `git rm` so history keeps it, and the removal is listed below so a pointer that
still names it has somewhere to land.

**This index is generated, and it distinguishes what a record DECLARES from what its filename
merely suggests.** The `kind` column is the filename prefix. The `state` column is a
declaration — frontmatter if a record carries any, else a `Status:` line in the head of its
body — and where there is neither it says **UNKNOWN**, because reading `PROPOSED-` in a
filename as a ratification is the guess this page refuses to make. The retired list is derived
from `git log --diff-filter=D`, which is the only place a removed record still exists.

## Declared bundle-relative paths

`data/…`, `ontology/…`, `acceptance/…` and the like in these records name files of an
APPLIED ontology, not paths in this repository. **Read** means read by
`check_dangling_references`, whose own reader looks only at a record's opening lines; the
second column is the same declaration found anywhere in the record's head, so a declaration
the gate cannot see shows up as a gap between the two rather than as nothing.

## What holds this index

`python3 tools/gen_decisions_index.py` writes this page. `python3
tools/check_decisions_index.py` — which `tools/run_framework_gates.sh` runs, because the suite
globs `check_*.py` — rejects it on four separate grounds: the index is **missing**; the index is
**stale** against a fresh render; a record **exists on disk and this index does not link it**;
a record **git records as removed is not named on it**. The last two are asserted from the
filesystem and from git history against the text of this page as written, not from the
renderer's own model — so a renderer that silently drops a row is caught by evidence that
cannot agree with it.
